places.name: Perry's Grillz
places.area: Mahé — Les Canelles Road (between Anse Royale and Anse à la Mouche)
places.near: Les Canelles Road, in the hills between Anse Royale and Anse à la Mouche — but the point is delivery: phone your order and they bring it to your beach or villa (Sept-Apr)
places.order: Charcoal-grilled whole job fish or red snapper, grilled tuna steak, grilled prawns, with breadfruit chips, rice and Creole chatini
places.notes: Verified via seyvillas Mahé restaurant guide (delivery Sept-Apr, ~SCR 550) and Tripadvisor 'delivery only' listing (4.8)
places.famousFor: The island's cult charcoal grill — everything cooked over local coconut-shell charcoal, rated 4.8-4.9 and delivered straight to your beach picnic
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.9 ★ (910) · Confirmed operating; effectively DELIVERY/TAKEAWAY ONLY, not a sit-down room — do not turn up expecting a dining room. Phone orders required, ideally the morning of. Around SCR 550 for a three-course meal with delivery — outstanding value ($). CASH on delivery. DIETARY: charcoal-grilled fish is the whole menu's strength, no-pork is simple. The best-value way to feed seven people a proper Creole meal on a beach day. · Location needs verification

places.name: Château de Feuilles
places.area: Praslin — Pointe Cabris, Baie Ste Anne
places.near: Pointe Cabris, above Baie Ste Anne, east Praslin — ~10 min up the hill from the Baie Ste Anne jetty; steep private access road, take a taxi
places.order: Grilled lobster with garlic butter, fish of the day, Creole chicken curry; there is a rooftop viewpoint for a pre-dinner drink
places.notes: Verified via seyvillas Praslin restaurant guide (Château de Feuilles, Baie Ste Anne, 'among the best in the Seychelles')
places.famousFor: A hilltop Relais & Châteaux-calibre country house with a 360-degree view over Baie Ste Anne and the surrounding islands — consistently rated among the very best restaurants in Seychelles
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.9 ★ (159) · Confirmed operating. NON-RESIDENTS MUST BOOK IN ADVANCE — it is a small hotel restaurant and outside covers are limited; allow 3+ days. Top price band ($$$$). DIETARY: French-Creole menu, so state no-pork when reserving; lobster and fish carry the menu. The most grown-up dinner on Praslin — better as an adults' evening or with the older teenagers than with all five children. · Location needs verification
places.address: Pointe Cabris, Baie Ste Anne, Praslin

places.name: Chez Lamar
places.area: Mahé — Anse à la Mouche (west coast)
places.near: Anse à la Mouche, west Mahé, on the coast road between Anse Boileau and Baie Lazare — ~25-30 min from the airport across the mountain road
places.order: Octopus curry (the dish to come for), fish curry with coconut milk, grilled catch of the day
places.notes: Verified via koek.sc Mahé restaurants guide (Chez Lamar, Anse à la Mouche)
places.famousFor: A quiet local kitchen on the west coast that Seychellois recommend when they want honest Creole cooking without a resort mark-up
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.9 ★ (31) · Confirmed operating. Roughly 15% cheaper than the tourist-facing beach restaurants ($$). CASH-HEAVY: cash is preferred here, bring rupees. Quiet, unhurried atmosphere — call ahead the same day so they cook enough. DIETARY: curries are fish/octopus-based, no-pork is simple. · Location needs verification

places.name: Muse (Mango House Seychelles, LXR)
places.area: Mahé — Anse aux Poules Bleues (west coast)
places.near: Mango House Seychelles, Anse aux Poules Bleues, west coast Mahé near Anse à la Mouche — ~25-30 min from the airport over the mountain road
places.order: Regional Italian sharing plates, seafood pasta, wood-oven fish, burrata and vegetable antipasti
places.notes: Verified via hilton.com official Mango House dining page, Forbes Travel Guide and seyvillas Mahé guide
places.famousFor: The main restaurant of Mango House — the former home of photographer Gian Paolo Barbieri, now Hilton's LXR flagship — with a wide terrace over Anse aux Poules Bleues bay
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.7 ★ (557) · Confirmed operating; open all day, seven days a week (breakfast, lunch, dinner). Non-guests should call ahead. Top price band ($$$$). DIETARY: Italian menu carries cured pork — state no-pork when booking; the seafood and vegetable half of the menu is excellent. Thursday aperitivo 17:30-18:30 and a Saturday DJ from noon make it lively rather than hushed. The same property's Azido does Japanese robata, sushi and sashimi on the beach — the better choice if the family wants raw and grilled fish, and a strong no-pork option. · Location needs verification

places.name: Les Cocotiers (Hilton Seychelles Northolme)
places.cuisine: Creole and fresh local seafood, à la carte
places.near: Hilton Seychelles Northolme, North Coast Road, Glacis — ~10 min north of Beau Vallon, ~35-40 min from the airport
places.order: Whole grilled job fish or red snapper Creole-style, octopus curry, local lobster; the fish comes off boats a few bays away
places.notes: Verified via hilton.com official Northolme dining page and operator descriptions (Les Cocotiers / The Hilltop / Ocean View Bar)
places.famousFor: Alfresco à la carte dining on the cliff terrace of the Northolme — the Ian Fleming hotel — with the ocean directly below your table
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.6 ★ (1,337) · Confirmed operating. Booking required for non-residents — call the resort; the terrace is small and residents get first call, so allow a few days. Top price band ($$$$). DIETARY: à la carte Creole seafood, easy no-pork. The resort's other venue, The Hilltop, does themed buffet nights including a Seafood Experience with live cooking stations — better value and easier with five children than the à la carte terrace. Adults-oriented property overall; check the child policy when booking.

places.name: La Perle Noire
places.near: Beau Vallon, just back from the beach road — walkable from most Beau Vallon hotels, ~25-30 min from the airport
places.order: Lobster in whiskey sauce (the house dish), grilled fish of the day, seafood spaghetti, Creole curries
places.notes: Verified via seyvillas Mahé restaurant guide (4.5, 1,145 reviews) and evendo Seychelles restaurant ranking (4.6, 618 reviews)
places.famousFor: Theatrical pirate-galleon interior of carved wood and lanterns — the most atmospheric room on Beau Vallon, and one of the highest-rated restaurants on Mahé (4.6 from 600+ reviews)
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.6 ★ (871) · Confirmed operating. Dinner only in practice; it fills by about 19:15, so book 1-2 days ahead. $$$ (a 20-30% premium over neighbours). DIETARY: seafood and fish carry the menu — easy no-pork; alcohol served. The pirate-ship room is a genuine hit with kids, which makes it a rare atmospheric dinner that works for a table of seven. · Location needs verification

places.name: Maria's Rock Cafeteria
places.near: Anse Gouvernement, Baie Lazare, south-west Mahé, up the hill near the Anse Soleil turn-off — ~35 min from the airport; a steep narrow access road, take it slowly
places.order: The hot-stone platter with fresh fish and prawns; Creole sides of rice, lentils and chatini
places.notes: Verified via Tripadvisor Baie Lazare restaurant ranking (4.3, #1 of 17) and Tripexpert comparison page
places.famousFor: An eccentric hillside cafe covered in the owner's carved sculptures where you grill your own fish and meat on a searing hot volcanic stone at the table — #1 of 17 in Baie Lazare
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.6 ★ (607) · Confirmed operating (Tripadvisor 4.3, ranked #1 in Baie Lazare). Not expensive ($$). The cook-it-yourself stone is a genuine attraction for kids aged 5-17 — supervise the youngest, the stone is very hot. DIETARY: you choose your own proteins, so a fish-and-prawn-only table is trivial. Cash is the safe bet. Quirky, hand-built and not polished — go for the fun, not for fine dining. Call ahead; hours are informal. · Location needs verification

places.name: Les Rochers Restaurant & Boutique
places.area: Praslin — Anse St Sauveur (near Anse Lazio)
places.near: Anse St Sauveur, north-west Praslin, on the road between Baie Ste Anne and Anse Lazio — ~20 min from Baie Ste Anne jetty by car or taxi
places.order: Fresh octopus salad, grilled red snapper, catch of the day cooked simply; cocktails on the terrace before sunset
places.notes: Verified via seyvillas Praslin restaurant guide, Top25Restaurants Seychelles and Tripadvisor Praslin listing
places.famousFor: A 30-seat oceanfront terrace on the granite rocks of the north-west coast, on the road to Anse Lazio — small, precise, and one of the most-praised tables on Praslin
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.6 ★ (489) · Confirmed operating. Only 30 seats — BOOK 2-3 DAYS AHEAD, this is the one on Praslin where walk-ins get turned away. $$$. DIETARY: seafood-led, straightforward no-pork. Combine it with an Anse Lazio morning: swim, then drive five minutes for lunch. Small terrace and steps down to the rocks — keep an eye on the youngest. · Location needs verification

places.name: Cyann Restaurant (Constance Ephelia)
places.cuisine: French technique with global flavours; seafood
places.near: Constance Ephelia, Port Launay, north-west Mahé — ~40 min drive from the airport, ~25 min from Beau Vallon
places.order: Local reef fish with French sauces, lobster, seafood tasting plates; the kitchen's strength is fish cooked precisely
places.notes: Verified via constancehotels.com official Cyann and Ephelia restaurants pages
places.famousFor: Constance Ephelia's signature fine-dining room, right by the beach looking over the protected Port Launay Marine National Park
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.6 ★ (208) · Confirmed operating. Reservations required, and NON-GUESTS must arrange by phone or email with the resort in advance — do not just drive up. Casual-chic at lunch, more formal at dinner. Top price band ($$$$). DIETARY: fish-forward menu, no-pork is easy on request; alcohol served. If the family wants a lower-key alternative in the same resort, the sister restaurant Adam & Eve does South-East Asian (Malaysian/Thai/Indonesian) in a garden setting and suits children better.

places.name: The Nest (Constance Lémuria)
places.area: Praslin — Anse Kerlan / Petite Anse Kerlan
places.near: Constance Lémuria, Anse Kerlan, north-west Praslin — ~5-10 min from the Praslin airstrip, ~25 min from Baie Ste Anne jetty
places.order: Indian Ocean lobster, whole grilled reef fish Creole-style, octopus; the fish is landed locally
places.notes: Verified via constancehotels.com official Lémuria restaurants page, Forbes Travel Guide and LHW dining listing (non-guests must reserve)
places.famousFor: Perched alone on a rocky outcrop between the two Anse Kerlan beaches — the most dramatic sunset table on Praslin, doing Creole-style seafood
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.6 ★ (197) · Confirmed operating. NON-GUESTS MUST RESERVE — Lémuria requires outside diners to book in advance for all its restaurants; call or email the resort several days ahead. Top price band ($$$$). DIETARY: seafood-led, easy no-pork. If a wine dinner matters more than the view, the resort's Diva does Mediterranean cooking against a 23,000-bottle cellar. Exposed rocky outcrop with steps — fine for the older kids, watch the 5-year-old after dark.

places.name: Curieuse Restaurant
places.near: Anse Takamaka, north Praslin, near the Raffles side of the island — ~20 min from Baie Ste Anne jetty by taxi
places.order: Thai and Vietnamese salads, Indian curries (vegetarian and fish), tandoori-style fish, Asian vegetable dishes
places.notes: Verified via seyvillas Praslin restaurant guide (Curieuse Restaurant, Anse Takamaka, Chef Sunil Dutt)
places.famousFor: Chef Sunil Dutt's pan-Asian kitchen on the north Praslin coast — the island's antidote to a week of Creole fish, with a genuinely broad vegetarian section
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.6 ★ (99) · Confirmed operating. Booking advised, 1-2 days ahead. $$$. DIETARY: the strongest vegetarian and no-pork menu on Praslin by a distance — Indian and Thai vegetarian dishes plus fish throughout. Useful when the family has had enough grilled snapper. Small operation; call to confirm opening on the day, hours flex with the season.

places.name: Combava Restaurant
places.area: La Digue — La Passe / Anse Réunion waterfront
places.near: On the waterfront between La Passe jetty and Anse Réunion — a few minutes by bicycle or on foot from the jetty
places.order: Fresh catch cooked à la carte, seafood plates, and the properly built vegetarian dishes; there is a real wine list, rare on La Digue
places.notes: Verified via Tripadvisor Combava La Digue listing (roof terrace, à la carte, vegetarian/vegan options, recent positive reviews)
places.famousFor: A designed roof-terrace restaurant on a raised deck looking across the channel toward Praslin — the most polished, most 'restaurant-like' dining room on an island of beach shacks
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.6 ★ (48) · Confirmed operating, à la carte only (no buffet). BOOK AHEAD — it is a small roof terrace and the best-reviewed dinner room on the island. $$$-$$$$ by La Digue standards. DIETARY: explicit vegetarian and vegan options plus fish throughout, one of the easiest no-pork menus on the island. Sunset over Praslin from the deck is the reason to book the early sitting. Better suited to the older children than a restless 5-year-old. · Location needs verification

places.name: Café des Arts
places.near: On the sand at Anse Volbert / Côte d'Or, mid-Praslin — ~15 min from the Baie Ste Anne jetty, ~10 min from the Praslin airstrip
places.order: Octopus gratin with lobster (the signature), tuna carpaccio with caper-garlic-olive oil, sashimi, grilled catch of the day; the desserts are the island's best
places.notes: Verified via leducdepraslin.com official dining page, petitfute.co.uk Côte d'Or listing (Tue-Sun 12:00-22:00) and Tripadvisor Anse Volbert reviews
places.famousFor: Widely called Praslin's best restaurant — an art-gallery-turned-beach-restaurant sitting directly on Côte d'Or, one of the finest beaches in Seychelles
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.5 ★ (1,892) · Confirmed operating — it was reworked into a beach restaurant and beach club in 2021 and is trading in 2026. Open Tue-Sun 12:00-22:00; CLOSED MONDAYS. Book 2 days ahead for dinner. $$$. DIETARY: seafood, sushi and Creole fish dominate — very easy no-pork. Service can be slow at dinner when it is full; lunch is the smoother meal. DJ sets on Wed/Fri/Sat afternoons — fun for the teenagers, less so if you want quiet. · Location needs verification

places.name: Le Repaire Bar & Restaurant
places.near: Anse Réunion, on the west coast road ~10 min by bicycle south of La Passe jetty — La Digue is bike-and-oxcart island, there are almost no cars
places.order: Wood-fired pizzas, seafood pasta, grilled catch of the day, octopus carpaccio; the pizzas are the reliable crowd-pleaser for the kids
places.notes: Verified via anjaonadventure.com La Digue restaurant guide (2026, status: open) and Tripadvisor La Digue dinner ranking
places.famousFor: The best-regarded restaurant on La Digue — an Italian-run kitchen on the beach at Anse Réunion, with a wood-fired pizza oven and a romantic laid-back terrace over the water
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.5 ★ (1,850) · Confirmed operating. Higher-end for La Digue ($$$). BOOK — La Digue has very few good tables and this one fills nightly in season; a day or two ahead is enough, more over Christmas/Easter. DIETARY: Italian menu carries prosciutto/salami — order the seafood pizzas, seafood pasta and grilled fish and you are fine. Bring a torch or use your phone: the road back to La Passe after dinner is unlit.

places.name: Del Place
places.near: Port Glaud, north-west Mahé, on the road toward Constance Ephelia — ~35-40 min from the airport, ~25 min from Beau Vallon
places.order: Red snapper baked in banana leaf with coconut-lemongrass sauce (the signature), grilled octopus, tuna tartare, and the Creole tapas small plates
places.notes: Verified via delplace-seychelles.sc official site, Top25Restaurants and Tripadvisor review aggregate (4.5, 1,502 reviews)
places.famousFor: The locals' choice for serious seafood, on a jetty-side terrace over Port Launay bay with one of the island's best sunsets; open since 2014, ~4.5 from over 1,500 reviews
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.5 ★ (1,590) · Confirmed operating. DIETARY: fish- and octopus-led menu, very easy no-pork; alcohol served. Reserve 2-3 days ahead for a sunset table — the front row goes first. Premium ($$$), and some reviewers find it pricey and the service slow when full; go early rather than at peak. Live music Saturdays. Good for the family: open-air, casual dress, plenty of grilled fish the kids will eat. · Location needs verification

places.name: Mahek Restaurant
places.notes: Saved POI
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.4 ★ (1,126) · Arabic note 'مطعم هندي' (Indian restaurant) and the list's Gulf bias point to the Mahek (spelled with k) in Deira, Dubai; note a separate well-known 'Mahec' Indian restaurant exists at Le Meridien Dubai — confirm which is the saved pin

places.name: Trader Vic's (STORY Seychelles)
places.near: STORY Seychelles, Beau Vallon beachfront — walkable from anywhere on Beau Vallon bay, ~25-30 min from the airport
places.order: Wood-oven grilled seafood, Pan-Asian barbecue platters, the signature grills; ask for the catch of the day
places.notes: Verified via seyvillas Seychelles restaurant guide (Trader Vic's at STORY, Tue-Sun 18:00-23:00, reservations required)
places.famousFor: The Seychelles outpost of the global Trader Vic's name, on a garden veranda inside STORY Seychelles on Beau Vallon bay, with live music and performances
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.4 ★ (375) · Confirmed operating. Open Tue-Sun 18:00-23:00; closed Monday. RESERVATIONS REQUIRED, including for non-residents — book 2-3 days ahead in season. $$$-$$$$. DIETARY: barbecue and Asian menu, so ask about pork in the ribs/char siu items and stay with the seafood grills — plenty to work with. Live music and performance nights make it the most entertaining resort dinner on Beau Vallon for a family. Note the parent hotel STORY Seychelles is already on his saved list; this is the restaurant, booked separately.

places.name: La Scala Restaurant
places.cuisine: Italian fine dining with Seychellois produce
places.near: End of the road at Bel Ombre, past Beau Vallon on the north-west coast — ~10 min from Beau Vallon, ~40 min from the airport; narrow road, go before dark if you can
places.order: Handmade pasta (the family built its name on it), fresh-catch fish in Italian preparations, lobster; big, fairly priced wine list
places.notes: Verified via lascala.sc official site, Facebook page and Tripadvisor Bel Ombre ranking
places.famousFor: Run by the Torsi family since 1978 — nearly 50 years and still the island's benchmark Italian, on a terrace above the water past Beau Vallon
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.4 ★ (258) · Confirmed operating (Tripadvisor 4.4). DINNER ONLY. Book 48 hours ahead — it is small and fills. Tel +248 4247 535. Roughly SCR 600-900 for two courses ($$$). DIETARY: Italian menu means prosciutto/salami/bacon appear — say no-pork when booking and the kitchen adjusts easily; the seafood pasta and grilled fish are the reason to come anyway. Arrive before 19:30 for the last of the western light. Better for the older kids than the 5-year-old. · Location needs verification

places.name: The Boat House
places.near: Beau Vallon beach road, near the middle of the bay — walkable from Beau Vallon hotels
places.order: Work the buffet: fish curry, octopus curry, grilled tuna and job fish, breadfruit chips, lentils, chatini (chutneys), banana ladob for dessert
places.notes: Verified via seyvillas Mahé restaurant guide and Tripadvisor Beau Vallon listings
places.famousFor: A Beau Vallon fixture for decades — a nightly all-you-can-eat Creole buffet of 20+ traditional dishes for one fixed price, the fastest way to taste the whole cuisine in one sitting
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.3 ★ (1,331) · Confirmed operating, but quality is uneven — reviews sit around 3.5 and it is more about breadth than refinement. Buffet is the whole point, so it is excellent value for a family of seven and lets each person pick their own dishes. Fixed price, mid-range ($$). DIETARY: pork dishes usually appear somewhere on the buffet line — it is a buffet, so simply avoid them; fish and vegetable dishes dominate. Book same-day in high season. · Location needs verification
places.address: Beau Vallon Beach Road, Beau Vallon, Mahé

places.name: Chez Jules
places.near: Anse Banane, east coast of La Digue near Anse Fourmis — ~25-30 min by bicycle from La Passe on the flat coast road; it is the far side of the island, so plan the return before dark
places.order: Octopus curry (the reason people cycle across the island), tuna steak, grilled fish, and the homemade mango ice cream
places.notes: Verified via anjaonadventure.com La Digue guide (Anse Banane, open) and Tripadvisor/evendo La Digue rankings
places.famousFor: A remote east-coast kitchen with a handful of tables looking straight out at the sea — the island's most-loved Creole cooking, worth the ride out
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.3 ★ (1,018) · Confirmed operating. Higher-end for La Digue ($$$) — remote location, small kitchen. CALL AHEAD, same day at minimum: they cook to numbers and can run out. CASH-HEAVY, bring rupees. DIETARY: octopus and fish curries throughout, easy no-pork. The cycle out with five children is the real planning question — consider hiring the island taxi (one of the few pickups) for the youngest.

places.name: Surfers Beach Restaurant
places.cuisine: Creole / Indian / international, on the beach
places.near: Anse Parnel, Takamaka, south-east Mahé, on the coast road — ~30 min from the airport, right on the sand in front of Surfers Beach chalets
places.order: Exotic fish soup, grilled prawns, grilled fish of the day, Indian-spiced vegetarian curries
places.notes: Verified via Tripadvisor Surfers Beach Restaurant page (Takamaka) with 2026 reviews and stated hours
places.famousFor: A relaxed beach kitchen on a wild south-east coast bay with a strong Indian streak — a favourite for exotic fish soup and grilled prawns at prices well below the resort strip
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.3 ★ (894) · Confirmed operating (Tripadvisor 3.9). Open daily EXCEPT TUESDAYS, 12:00-21:00, last orders 20:30. Reasonably priced ($$) but a 10% service charge is added. DIETARY: the Indian side of the menu means genuine vegetarian options plus plenty of fish — one of the easiest no-pork menus on Mahé. Low tide flattens the beach into a huge play area for the kids. Walk-in is fine. · Location needs verification

places.name: Marie Antoinette Restaurant
places.near: Serret Road, St Louis, on the hill just above Victoria — 5-10 min by car from the capital, ~15 min from Beau Vallon
places.order: The set Creole spread: batter-fried parrotfish, grilled tuna steak, octopus curry (widely called the best on Mahé), aubergine fritters, lentils, rice and pumpkin chutney — all fish/veg, easy to keep no-pork
places.notes: Verified via seyvillas Mahé restaurant guide + Tripadvisor Victoria ranking + Top25Restaurants Seychelles listing
places.famousFor: The island's oldest Creole institution — open since 1972 in a 100-year-old colonial house that was declared a national monument in 2011; the menu has barely changed in 50 years
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.3 ★ (660) · Confirmed operating (Tripadvisor #3 of 42 in Victoria, 4.0). Mon-Sat, lunch 12:00-14:30 (last order 13:30), dinner from 18:30 (last order 21:00); closed Sunday. Set menu = no ordering decisions, portions generous and mostly fish/veg — the safest no-pork table on Mahé. Mid-range ($$). Book a day ahead in high season; rustic, not air-conditioned. Kids fine — it's a family house, not a hushed dining room. · Location needs verification
places.address: Serret Road, St Louis, Victoria, Mahé

places.name: ZEZ Restaurant & Bar (Four Seasons Resort Seychelles)
places.near: Four Seasons Resort Seychelles, Petite Anse, Baie Lazare, south-west Mahé — ~30 min by road from the airport; the resort runs buggies up the hillside to the restaurant
places.order: Sashimi and tartare of local tuna, the Sunday local catch of the day, wok and robata seafood plates, Asian vegetable sharing dishes
places.notes: Verified via fourseasons.com official ZEZ dining page and OpenTable listing (booking by phone, +248 4393000)
places.famousFor: The best-known resort signature restaurant in Seychelles — a hilltop pavilion high above Petite Anse with a near-aerial Indian Ocean view and a genuinely ambitious Pan-Asian kitchen
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.3 ★ (30) · Confirmed operating. NON-GUESTS: call the resort directly on +248 4393000 — outside diners are taken subject to availability and are not booked through OpenTable; do this several days ahead, and expect to be asked to confirm. Top price band ($$$$). DIETARY: Pan-Asian sharing menu is seafood- and vegetable-heavy, so no-pork is easy — but flag it when booking, as some Asian dishes use pork stock. Dinner is the show (sunset from the hill); smart-casual. Fine for the older children, less so for the 5-year-old late at night.

places.name: Kafe Kreol
places.near: Anse Royale beachfront on the east coast road — ~15 min from the airport, ~30 min from Victoria
places.order: Grilled fish of the day, octopus salad, fish curry; wood-fired pizza and fresh pasta for the younger kids
places.notes: Verified via Tripadvisor Anse Royale reviews (2026) and evendo Anse Royale restaurant ranking; hours 10:00-22:00 daily
places.famousFor: All-day beachfront dining with tables literally in the sand at Anse Royale — the most reliable and most accessible Creole lunch on the east coast
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.2 ★ (1,403) · Confirmed operating. Open daily 10:00-22:00 — one of the few genuinely all-day kitchens, useful with children who eat off-schedule. Mid-range ($$). DIETARY: Creole seafood plus vegetarian pastas and pizzas; avoid the ham/bacon pizzas and it is an easy no-pork table. Walk-in friendly; book only for a large group on a weekend evening. · Location needs verification

places.name: Café/Restaurant Le Jardin du Roi
places.cuisine: Creole, spiced from the estate's own garden
places.near: 2 km up into the hills above Anse Royale, signposted from the east coast road — ~20 min from the airport; a rental car or taxi is needed, the road climbs
places.order: Octopus curry, the day's grilled fish cooked with estate spices (vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg), tomato salad, homemade coconut ice cream and fresh juices
places.notes: Verified via Tripadvisor Le Jardin du Roi attraction and restaurant pages (2026 reviews) plus operator listings
places.famousFor: The restaurant of an 18th-century-style 35-hectare spice plantation, on a veranda with a huge view down to the east coast — and giant tortoises wandering the grounds
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.2 ★ (1,185) · Confirmed operating. LUNCH ONLY — the garden and cafe close mid-afternoon. Pay the small garden admission and make an outing of it: self-guided spice walk, rainforest trail and tortoises before lunch, which buys you an hour of happy kids. Mid-range ($$). DIETARY: fish and vegetable Creole dishes throughout, no-pork is easy. No booking usually needed midweek; call in peak season. · Location needs verification

places.name: Coco Rouge Take Away & Cafeteria
places.near: Baie Ste Anne, east Praslin, near the jetty — walkable from the ferry terminal, which makes it the perfect arrival or departure-day lunch
places.order: Fish curry with rice, grilled fish, octopus curry, lentils and chatini — ask for whatever came in that morning
places.notes: Verified via seyvillas Praslin restaurant guide (Coco Rouge Take Away & Cafeteria, Baie Ste Anne, 'excellent quality', low prices)
places.famousFor: Praslin's queue-worthy local takeaway — proper Creole cooking at a fraction of restaurant prices, which is why the island's own workers eat here
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.2 ★ (578) · Confirmed operating. Takeaway/cafeteria format — plastic chairs, not a restaurant experience, but the food is the real thing. Budget ($). CASH ONLY in practice; bring small rupee notes. Go at 12:00-12:30 — the good dishes sell out and it closes early afternoon. DIETARY: fish curries and vegetable sides make no-pork simple; ask, as some Creole takeaways run a pork dish daily.

places.name: La Grande Maison
places.area: Mahé — Au Cap (La Plaine St André)
places.near: La Plaine St André, East Coast Road, Au Cap — ~15 min south of Victoria, ~10 min from the airport; combine with the Takamaka Rum distillery tour on the same estate
places.order: Creole bouillabaisse, seafood au coco (fish and shellfish in coconut), tuna carpaccio, and the tapas-style small plates at lunch; skip the house pork rum-and-raisin signature
places.notes: Verified via Lonely Planet Seychelles East Coast listing, petitfute.co.uk Au Cap page and Takamaka Rum official site
places.famousFor: Belgian chef Christelle Verheyden — widely called the most talented chef in Seychelles — cooking a near-daily-changing menu inside a restored 1792 colonial house on the Takamaka Rum estate
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.2 ★ (88) · Confirmed operating. Open Tue-Sat 11:30-22:00; closed Sun-Mon. Tel +248 2 522 112. Booking 2-3 days ahead is genuinely needed for dinner — it is small and it is the table everyone wants. DIETARY: the kitchen is proudly pork-friendly (pork is a listed signature) and this is a rum distillery, so alcohol is everywhere — but the fish and seafood half of the menu is outstanding and staff will steer you. Premium ($$$). Live music Wed & Sat. · Location needs verification
places.address: La Plaine St André, East Coast Road, Au Cap, Mahé

places.name: Ochan! Waterfront Bistro
places.cuisine: Multi-cuisine: South Indian, Arabic, European, Asian
places.near: Eden Plaza, Eden Island marina — Eden Island is joined to Mahé by a short causeway near Providence, ~10 min from the airport and ~10 min from Victoria
places.order: South Indian fish curry and dosa, Arabic grills and mezze, fresh catch from the marina, plus Western plates for the kids
places.notes: Verified via ochansey.com official site, Eden Plaza tenant page and Tripadvisor Eden Island #1 ranking (4.6, 188 reviews)
places.famousFor: The #1-ranked restaurant on Eden Island (4.6) — a marina-side bistro deliberately built around six cuisines under one roof, including South Indian and Arabic
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.2 ★ (59) · Confirmed operating. Open daily 11:00-22:00; tel +248 2 811 465. Mid-range ($$). DIETARY: the strongest pick on this list for the family — a real South Indian vegetarian section plus Arabic grills means the no-pork question barely arises, and there is Western food for the younger kids. Outdoor family seating, live music some nights. Book for a group of seven at weekends. Eden Plaza has a supermarket and shops if the teenagers get restless. · Location needs verification

places.name: Zerof Restaurant & Takeaway
places.near: L'Union Road, a few minutes by bicycle from La Passe jetty on the way to L'Union Estate
places.order: The buffet: grilled fish, fish and octopus curry, lentils, breadfruit, salads and Creole chutneys; or a takeaway box to eat on the beach
places.notes: Verified via anjaonadventure.com La Digue restaurants and takeaways guide (Zerof, L'Union, buffet, budget, open)
places.famousFor: La Digue's long-running local buffet — a garden dining room where the island eats, doing grilled fish and a spread of Creole curries at a fraction of the beach-restaurant price
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.1 ★ (337) · Confirmed operating. Budget ($) — by far the best value on La Digue and the practical answer to feeding seven people every night on an island where dinner is expensive. CASH-HEAVY. Buffet nights fill; call the same day to check what is on and to reserve. DIETARY: the buffet usually includes a pork dish alongside the fish and vegetable dishes — simply avoid that tray; everything else is fish, chicken or vegetable. Plain garden setting, no view, honest cooking. · Location needs verification

places.name: Baobab Pizzeria
places.near: North Coast Road, Mare Anglaise, at the northern end of Beau Vallon beach — walkable along the sand from most Beau Vallon hotels
places.order: Wood-oven pizzas and pasta for the kids; grilled catch of the day, octopus salad and fresh juices for the adults
places.notes: Verified via seyvillas Mahé guide and evendo Seychelles ranking (4.0, 966 reviews)
places.famousFor: Toes-in-the-sand pizza under a huge baobab tree at the quiet end of Beau Vallon beach — the default easy family meal on Mahé, ~1,500 reviews
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4 ★ (1,157) · Confirmed operating (4.0 from ~1,500 reviews). No booking needed — walk in, though it gets busy at sunset. Budget to mid-range ($$). DIETARY: order the margherita/vegetarian pizzas or seafood pizzas and skip anything with ham, bacon, salami or 'diavola'; ask, as pork toppings are on the menu. Beach right there, so the kids can go straight back to the water. · Location needs verification
places.address: North Coast Road, Mare Anglaise, Beau Vallon, Mahé

places.name: Capricorn Restaurant
places.near: Islander Guesthouse, Anse Kerlan, west Praslin — ~5 min from the Praslin airstrip, ~20 min from Baie Ste Anne jetty
places.order: Fish curry, grilled catch of the day, chicken curry, Creole vegetable sides
places.notes: Verified via seyvillas Praslin restaurant guide (Capricorn at Islander Guesthouse, Anse Kerlan)
places.famousFor: The restaurant of the long-running Islander Guesthouse, right on Anse Kerlan beach — an unpretentious Creole kitchen locals send visitors to, in the shadow of the big resorts
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 3.9 ★ (158) · Confirmed operating. Mid-range ($$) — noticeably cheaper than the Côte d'Or beach restaurants. CASH-HEAVY: small guesthouse operation, bring rupees. Call the same day so they cook enough; menus at places this size are driven by what came off the boat. DIETARY: fish and chicken curries, easy no-pork. Simple and family-friendly rather than polished. · Location needs verification

places.name: Chez Batista
places.near: Anse Takamaka, south-west Mahé, on the coast road — ~35-40 min from the airport, ~50 min from Beau Vallon; pair it with a Takamaka beach afternoon
places.order: Grilled red snapper with rougaille (tomato-onion) sauce, grilled job fish, octopus curry, grilled lobster; the Sunday buffet if you can time it
places.notes: Verified via chezbatista.com official restaurant page + koek.sc Mahé dining guide
places.famousFor: Thatched roof, sand floor, feet-in-the-sand tables directly on Anse Takamaka — the most photographed restaurant in Seychelles, and its Sunday Creole buffet is an island institution
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 3.7 ★ (580) · Confirmed operating. Call the morning of your visit — terrace seating is allocated day by day and the Sunday buffet needs numbers. Mains roughly SCR 250-450 ($$-$$$). DIETARY: fish and seafood dominate; no-pork is straightforward. Sand, shade and a beach 10 m away make this the easiest lunch with five kids on the whole island. Cash is welcome; card usually works but do not rely on it alone. · Location needs verification

places.name: Bonbon Plume
places.near: On the sand at Anse Lazio, north-west Praslin — ~25 min by car/taxi from Baie Ste Anne jetty over the hill; buses are infrequent, arrange a taxi return
places.order: Grilled parrotfish, octopus curry, mussels Seychellois, grilled scallops, grilled lobster; classic Creole home cooking done properly
places.notes: Verified via seychelles.travel official restaurant listing (lunch 12:30-15:00 daily, closed June) and evendo Praslin ranking
places.famousFor: More than 20 years as Praslin's most-loved independent kitchen — a thatched pavilion in the palms directly on Anse Lazio, routinely called one of the world's most beautiful beaches
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 3.6 ★ (88) · Confirmed operating. LUNCH ONLY, daily 12:30-15:00 — dinner is by request for groups of 10+ only. CLOSED FOR THE WHOLE OF JUNE every year: check the calendar before planning around it. $$$ (beachfront pricing, lobster is expensive). DIETARY: entirely fish and shellfish led, the easiest no-pork lunch on Praslin. Book ahead in high season; bring cash as backup, card connectivity at Anse Lazio can be patchy.

places.name: Loutier Coco
places.near: Grand Anse, south-east La Digue — ~25 min by bicycle from La Passe with one steep hill in the middle; combine with Grand Anse / Petite Anse / Anse Cocos beach walk
places.order: The buffet when it runs: grilled fish, captain-fish curry, lentils, salads, fresh fruit and coffee; à la carte grilled fish otherwise
places.notes: Verified via Lonely Planet La Digue restaurants listing (buffet by pre-order) and anjaonadventure.com La Digue guide
places.famousFor: The only kitchen on Grand Anse, the huge wild surf beach on La Digue's far side — famous for a lunchtime Creole buffet of grilled fish, curries, salads and tropical fruit
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 3.4 ★ (180) · Confirmed operating (refurbished 2016). IMPORTANT: the famous buffet only runs when pre-ordered by a larger group — CALL AHEAD to find out when one is scheduled and time your visit to it; otherwise you get the standard à la carte. Reviews are genuinely mixed, so treat it as the convenient Grand Anse lunch rather than a destination meal. Mid-range ($$), CASH-HEAVY. DIETARY: fish and vegetable buffet, easy no-pork. Note: it is at Grand Anse, NOT at Anse Source d'Argent — for that beach see Lanbousir.

places.name: Lanbousir Restaurant
places.area: La Digue — Anse Source d'Argent (L'Union Estate)
places.near: At the Anse Source d'Argent end of L'Union Estate, La Digue — cycle 10 min from La Passe to L'Union, pay the estate entry, then walk/cycle through to the beach
places.order: Grilled fish of the day, octopus curry, Creole salads, fresh juices and coconut water
places.notes: Verified via petitfute.co.uk Anse Source d'Argent restaurant listing (Lanbousir, only restaurant at the beach entrance)
places.famousFor: The only restaurant at the entrance to Anse Source d'Argent — the most photographed beach in the world — with tables in the sand under the takamaka shade and lagoon views
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 2.8 ★ (85) · Confirmed operating. LUNCH ONLY, tied to L'Union Estate opening hours — you must pay the estate entrance fee to reach it. Despite having a monopoly on the most-visited beach in Seychelles it has kept normal prices ($$) and honest cooking, which is unusual and worth knowing. CASH is safest. DIETARY: grilled fish and Creole vegetable dishes, easy no-pork. Perfect midday break between two Anse Source d'Argent swims with the children. · Location needs verification
places.address: L'Union Estate, Anse Source d'Argent, La Digue

places.name: Glorious Café and Bakery
places.near: Second floor of the Olivier Maradan Building in central Victoria, near the Clock Tower and the Sir Selwyn Selwyn-Clarke Market.
places.order: Fresh croissants and baguette; the local fish samosas; a filled sandwich and coffee to take to the market.
places.notes: SEYBUSINESS listing for Glorious Cafe and Bakery Mahé + Boombastic Seychelles cafés guide (founded 1968, location).
places.famousFor: A Seychellois bakery institution running since 1968 — the everyday morning bread, croissant and samosa counter of Victoria.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.8 ★ (528) · Early opening on weekdays (bakery hours from around 07:00), early close Saturday, closed Sunday. Cheap — a pastry-and-coffee breakfast for the whole family costs very little. Cash is safest. It is a bakery counter with seating, not a restaurant, so no bookings. Pair it with a walk through the market next door. · Location needs verification
places.address: Olivier Maradan Building, 2nd floor, Victoria, Mahé

places.name: The Station Seychelles Restaurant
places.near: Sans Souci Road, the mountain pass linking Victoria to Port Glaud on the west coast — 15–20 min uphill drive from Victoria; hire car or taxi (the bus is infrequent and the road is steep).
places.order: The vegetarian brunch plate and a fresh juice; whatever is on the wholesome daily board; then browse the on-site Lily Moon health shop.
places.notes: thestationseychelles.com official site + Tripadvisor listing for The Station Seychelles Restaurant (cuisine, meals served, location).
places.famousFor: Seychelles' health retreat in the mountains — the old FEBA radio station at 250 m on the Sans Souci pass, with the country's most serious vegetarian and vegan brunch and a huge ocean view.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.8 ★ (44) · Breakfast, brunch and lunch daily; call ahead as it is a small hotel restaurant and non-resident tables should be booked. Mid to upper-mid pricing. Fully vegetarian- and vegan-friendly — the best address on Mahé for that. Cool mountain air, quiet, and no alcohol focus at all. Steep access road; not ideal after dark. · Location needs verification
places.address: Sans Souci Road, Sans Souci, Mahé

places.name: Le Dauphin Restaurant (Le Duc de Praslin)
places.near: Anse Volbert (Côte d'Or), Praslin — on the main Côte d'Or road, walking distance from the beach and the Anse Volbert shops; ~20 min from Praslin airport.
places.order: Local Creole breakfast items alongside the eggs; tropical fruit and fresh juice; strong coffee before a Vallée de Mai or Anse Lazio day.
places.notes: leducdepraslin.com dining page for Le Dauphin Restaurant (buffet breakfast, 07:30–11:00).
places.famousFor: Praslin's best-known hotel breakfast buffet on the Côte d'Or strip — Creole delicacies alongside international classics, a short walk from Anse Volbert beach.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.7 ★ (1,157) · Breakfast 07:30–11:00 daily. Honest caveat: the buffet is designed for hotel residents and no public non-guest price is published — email or phone the hotel a day ahead to ask if outside diners can join and at what rate. Cards accepted. Easier to combine with a walk on Anse Volbert than any resort breakfast on Mahé. · Location needs verification

places.name: Glorious Bakery & Snacks
places.near: La Passe, La Digue, a short walk or cycle from the ferry jetty on the main village street.
places.order: Fish samosas straight out of the fryer; a fresh baguette and a quiche; custom cakes if you are marking something.
places.notes: SEYBUSINESS and mindtrip listings for Glorious Bakery & Snacks, La Passe + anjaonadventure.com La Digue guide.
places.famousFor: La Digue's morning bakery — the fish samosas are a local legend and the counter is open from 07:00 with the day's bread.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.7 ★ (17) · Opens from around 07:00 — the earliest breakfast option on La Digue. Cheap; cash. Counter/takeaway with limited seating, so buy and take it to the beach or eat on the way to Anse Source d'Argent. Also runs a breakfast and lunch menu, sandwiches, platters and European deli items.

places.name: Le Repaire
places.near: Anse Réunion, La Digue — a 5–10 minute cycle south from the La Passe ferry jetty along the coast road.
places.order: Italian-style breakfast with proper espresso and pastry; wood-fired pizza or the seafood pasta later.
places.notes: anjaonadventure.com La Digue restaurants and takeaways guide (2026).
places.famousFor: The best-run Italian kitchen on La Digue, in a beachfront setting at Anse Réunion; it opens for breakfast as well as lunch and dinner.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.5 ★ (1,850) · Breakfast, lunch and dinner. The higher-priced end of La Digue eating. Booking recommended, especially for dinner and for a group of seven. Cards more likely accepted here than at the takeaways, but carry cash. Real espresso — a rarity on the island.

places.name: Corossol Restaurant (Constance Ephelia)
places.cuisine: International buffet breakfast with live cooking stations
places.near: Constance Ephelia, Port Launay, north-west Mahé — ~40 min drive from Seychelles International Airport; hire car or taxi, and you must check in at the resort gate.
places.order: Made-to-order eggs Benedict or a filled omelette at the egg station; the tropical fruit and fresh-juice spread; the Asian noodle station for something different.
places.notes: Constance Hotels official Corossol page and seychelles.travel restaurant entry (hours, buffet stations).
places.famousFor: The biggest and best-known resort breakfast buffet on Mahé — live egg, wok, tandoor and pizza-oven stations a few metres from the sand at Port Launay Marine National Park.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.5 ★ (97) · Continental 04:30–07:00, full buffet breakfast 07:00–10:30 daily. Honest caveat: this is primarily a resident buffet and no public walk-in price is published — non-guests must phone the resort in advance to ask whether a table and a per-person rate are available, and expect a resort-level charge (typically EUR 35–50 per adult at this class of hotel in Seychelles). Cards accepted. Vegetarian and halal-suitable options are plentiful at a buffet this size. · Location needs verification

places.name: Jenny's Bakery
places.cuisine: Seychellois bakery, local cakes and pastries
places.near: Same premises as No1 Baie Sainte Anne, Old School Building, Baie Sainte Anne, Praslin — walkable from the Cat Cocos / La Digue ferry jetty.
places.order: Coconut tart and lapatsek; shortbread or brownies for the road; take them next door to No1 Baie Ste Anne for coffee.
places.notes: Seychelles Nation article on No1 Baie Ste Anne, describing Jenny Pomeroy's 30-year bakery on the same premises.
places.famousFor: Thirty-plus years of Praslin baking by Jenny Pomeroy — the source of the local cakes 'lapatsek', 'mafelisi' and coconut tarts sold at the coffee shop that grew out of it.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.4 ★ (76) · Morning-focused bakery hours; go early, the local cakes sell out. Very cheap; cash. Counter service only — the seating is on the coffee-shop side. The single best place on Praslin to try genuine Seychellois cakes rather than hotel pastry. · Location needs verification
places.address: Old School Building, Baie Sainte Anne, Praslin

places.name: Boat House
places.near: Just off Beau Vallon beach on the north-west coast of Mahé, ~25–30 min from Seychelles International Airport; regular buses from Victoria over the Bel Air pass.
places.order: The cooked breakfast with tropical fruit and local jam; return in the evening for the Creole buffet if you want the full local spread.
places.notes: Inside Seychelles listings for BoatHouse Restaurant and Bar / Creole Buffet at Boat House (hours, contacts).
places.famousFor: The Beau Vallon beach classic — best known for its 20-dish Creole buffet, but it opens at 06:00 on weekdays and is one of the few genuinely early breakfasts on Mahé.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.3 ★ (1,331) · Breakfast every weekday 06:00–10:00; the restaurant then runs 10:00 until 23:00–midnight, seven days. Tel +248 4 247 898 / WhatsApp +248 2 817 037. Mid-priced breakfast; the evening Creole buffet is a fixed price per head. Book by WhatsApp for a group of seven. Alcohol is served in the evening but breakfast service is straightforward. · Location needs verification

places.name: La Goulue Café Créole Restaurant
places.near: Cap Samy, on the north-west side of Praslin between Anse Kerlan and Grand Anse; car or taxi — Praslin's bus is slow on this stretch. Tel +248 4 232 223.
places.order: The Creole breakfast plate with tropical fruit and local bread; coffee or citronelle tea under the trees.
places.notes: Wanderlog Praslin restaurants list entry for La Goulue Cafe Creole Restaurant (breakfast hours, phone, setting).
places.famousFor: Breakfast in an 18th-century spice garden — an old-Praslin garden setting with à la carte Creole cooking rather than a hotel buffet.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.3 ★ (551) · Breakfast served 09:30–11:00 only, then à la carte through the day — this is a late-morning breakfast, not an early one. Mid-priced. Booking recommended for a group; call ahead as small Praslin restaurants close on quiet days. Garden seating, shaded, good with children. · Location needs verification

places.name: Gala Takeaway
places.near: L'Union, La Digue, close to the entrance for Anse Source d'Argent — cycle from La Passe in about 10 minutes.
places.order: The cheap breakfast plate; later, lamb or fish curry with rice; a fresh juice or milkshake alongside.
places.notes: anjaonadventure.com La Digue guide + Tripadvisor ranking for Gala Takeaway, La Digue.
places.famousFor: The cheapest honest food on La Digue — a takeaway counter locals and repeat visitors rank as the island's best-value kitchen, with an affordable breakfast option.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.1 ★ (973) · Daytime and evening; dishes run out, so go early. Among the lowest prices on the island — a real relief on La Digue. Cash only. Takeaway with limited seating; ideal to carry to the beach. Ranked in the island's top ten on Tripadvisor with nearly 1,000 reviews.

places.name: Fish Trap Restaurant & Bar
places.near: La Passe seafront, a one-minute walk from the La Digue ferry jetty where the boats from Praslin and Mahé arrive.
places.order: Breakfast with a fresh tropical juice; grilled fish later in the day.
places.notes: anjaonadventure.com La Digue restaurants and takeaways guide (2026).
places.famousFor: The family-friendly waterfront spot right by the La Digue ferry jetty — the natural first or last meal on the island, and it serves breakfast.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4 ★ (1,263) · Breakfast, lunch and dinner daily. Reasonable prices for La Digue. Cash preferred. Family-friendly with easy seating for a large group and the most convenient location on the island for a ferry-day breakfast. It has a bar, but the setting is a family restaurant.

places.name: News Cafe
places.near: First floor of Trinity House, central Victoria, a two-minute walk from the Clock Tower and the Sir Selwyn-Clarke Market; all island buses terminate at the Victoria bus station nearby.
places.order: The full breakfast plate; a tramezzini or panini later in the morning; the Creole or Thai salad if you slide into lunch.
places.notes: near-place.com and Petit Futé listings for News Cafe, Trinity House, Victoria (hours, phone, menu).
places.famousFor: The capital's long-standing breakfast table — a first-floor balcony in Trinity House overlooking Victoria's streets, known for generous breakfasts.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 3.9 ★ (116) · Mon–Fri 08:30–17:00, Sat 08:30–15:00, closed Sunday. Tel +248 4 322 999. Mid-priced; cards generally accepted in Victoria but keep rupees as backup. No booking needed. Indoor and balcony seating; ask for the balcony. Vegetarian options available on request. · Location needs verification

places.name: Shark's Ice Cream
places.near: Zone 18, Providence Industrial Estate, ~10 min south of Victoria on the East Coast Road — an easy detour on the way to/from the airport.
places.order: Corossol (soursop), mango and passion-fruit sorbets; tiramisu or Nutella gelato; the sugar-free range if anyone in the family is watching sugar.
places.notes: Official site sharksicecream.webflow.io (address, hours, flavour list); no verified coordinates published, so left blank.
places.famousFor: A 100% Seychellois ice-cream maker of 20+ years — over 40 flavours split into gelatos, tropical sorbets and sugar-free (stevia) lines; the ice cream you'll meet in cafés and hotels all over the islands.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 5 ★ (4) · This is the production site/outlet, open Mon–Fri 07:30–16:00 only (tel 4373780) — not an evening dessert stop. If you can't get there, ask for Shark's by name at cafés and hotel restaurants. · Location needs verification
places.address: Industrial Estate Providence, Zone 18, Victoria, Mahé

places.name: POPSEY Popsicles
places.area: Mahé — Le Rocher (sold island-wide at hotels, cafés & beach kiosks)
places.near: Not a shop front — sold at hotels, restaurants, beach kiosks and events across Mahé, Praslin and La Digue; base is at Brillant Residence, Le Rocher, Mahé.
places.order: Mango, coconut, passion fruit, lime and lemongrass; pineapple + chilli for whoever wants the grown-up one.
places.notes: Official site popsey.sc (product, stockists, contact); no shop-front coordinates published, so left blank.
places.famousFor: Handmade all-natural popsicles built from seasonal Seychelles fruit — no colourings, no preservatives; the easiest 'tropical fruit sorbet' fix on a hot beach day.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 5 ★ (3) · Fruit-only pops are dairy-free and kid-proof. WhatsApp +248 2515591 to ask where the nearest stockist is; they also do event/party orders, useful for a big family group. · Location needs verification

places.name: Delicious Cakes Seychelles
places.near: Riverside Point, Mont Buxton, on the northern edge of Victoria — 5 min by car from the town centre.
places.order: A slice of the Oreo cheesecake, an éclair, and a Napoleon slice; whole cakes to order for a birthday on the trip.
places.notes: Wanderlog review page + the shop's own Facebook/Instagram posts (Riverside Point, Mont Buxton); no verified coordinates, left blank.
places.famousFor: Victoria's go-to cake counter — reviewers single out the Oreo cheesecake, éclairs and mille-feuille (Napoleon), plus milkshakes and good coffee.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.7 ★ (52) · Order whole cakes a day ahead via their Facebook/Instagram — useful if you want a cake delivered to a villa or hotel for a family of 7. · Location needs verification
places.address: Riverside Point, Mont Buxton, Victoria, Mahé

places.name: Kaz Cafe at Kaz Zanana
places.near: Revolution Avenue in central Victoria, a 5-minute walk from the clock tower and the Selwyn-Clarke market — pair it with a morning in town.
places.order: Cheesecake, the homemade cookies, and an iced coffee; light vegan and gluten-free options are on the board too.
places.notes: Tripadvisor Kaz Cafe / Kaz Zanana listings + Holidify gallery entry; coordinates from OpenStreetMap/Nominatim.
places.famousFor: The little café inside artist George Camille's Kaz Zanana gallery — a listed 1997-restored Creole timber house that is itself a cultural-heritage building; cake and coffee surrounded by Seychellois art.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.7 ★ (11) · Small and popular at lunchtime; the gallery upstairs is free to browse and is a genuinely good rainy-hour stop with older kids. Closed Sundays like most of Victoria.

places.name: Yvon's Bakery
places.near: Beau Vallon, north-west Mahé, on the main strip behind the beach; ~25 min from the airport.
places.order: Morning baguettes and sweet buns for breakfast; coconut tarts and slab cake for the beach bag.
places.notes: Tripadvisor listing 'Yvon's Bakery, Beau Vallon, Mahe Island'; no verified coordinates found, left blank.
places.famousFor: The everyday bakery on the Beau Vallon side — cheap fresh bread, buns and cakes for a self-catering family, minutes from the beach.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.6 ★ (25) · A local bakery, not a destination patisserie — reviews are mixed and it's best judged by what's out of the oven that morning. Go early. · Location needs verification

places.name: Maison Marengo
places.area: Mahé — Au Cap (entrance of Domaine de Val des Prés)
places.near: East coast road at Au Cap, at the entrance to the Domaine de Val des Prés craft village; ~10 min north of the airport, easy first- or last-day stop.
places.order: Ladob (ripe plantain or cassava simmered in coconut milk with vanilla and nutmeg) and nougat coco — the soft grated-coconut nougat; Sunday Creole BBQ buffet with live music if the timing works.
places.notes: seychelles.com blog feature + maison-marengo.com; coordinates from OpenStreetMap/Nominatim.
places.famousFor: A restored Creole house on the east coast with a 100% Seychellois kitchen, and the most reliable place to actually eat the island's traditional sweets rather than read about them.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.5 ★ (411) · Open lunch and dinner Mon–Sat, Sunday buffet with music; book ahead for 7. Menu is seafood/Creole-led (pork appears on Creole menus — order the fish, chicken or vegetable dishes and ask). Combine with the craft village next door.
places.address: Bois Joli Road, Domaine de Val des Prés, Au Cap, Mahé

places.name: Ô Saveurs des Îles (City Mall, Victoria)
places.near: Central Victoria, a couple of minutes' walk from the clock tower and the Selwyn-Clarke market; easy to fold into a morning in town before driving on.
places.order: Mango or passion-fruit sorbet (50%+ fresh fruit), corossol (soursop), coconut, and whatever seasonal tropical flavour is on the board that day.
places.notes: Instagram @o_saveurs_des_iles_seychelles + SEYBUSINESS listing (branches, flavours); coordinates from OpenStreetMap/Nominatim.
places.famousFor: Handmade, 100% natural ice cream and full-fruit sorbets by ice-cream maker Gérard Patti — 30+ rotating flavours, no additives, colourings or preservatives, churned on site.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.5 ★ (201) · Sorbets are dairy-free and fruit-only — a good option for the kids and for anyone avoiding milk. Cash (SCR) is easiest; town shops shut early and most close Sunday. Two branches: Victoria and Beau Vallon.
places.address: City Mall, Quincy Street, Victoria, Mahé

places.name: Ô Saveurs des Îles (Beau Vallon)
places.area: Mahé — Beau Vallon (Blue Sea Divers building)
places.near: On the North Coast Road strip at Beau Vallon, in the Blue Sea Divers building, ~25 min from the airport and a short walk from the main beach car park.
places.order: A scoop of coconut plus a fruit sorbet (mango, passion, lychee) to eat walking back along Beau Vallon beach.
places.notes: SEYBUSINESS + Instagram listings confirm the Beau Vallon (Blue Sea Diver building) branch; no verified coordinates found, so left blank.
places.famousFor: The beach-side branch of Seychelles' best-known artisan gelato maker — same 30+ natural flavours, right where the family will already be swimming.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.5 ★ (201) · Best late afternoon after the beach; the Beau Vallon strip also has Behram's pharmacy and a Cable & Wireless shop within a 2-minute walk. · Location needs verification
places.address: Blue Sea Divers building, North Coast Road, Beau Vallon, Mahé

places.name: Afternoon tea at DoubleTree by Hilton Seychelles – Allamanda
places.area: Mahé — Anse Forbans, Quatre Bornes (south coast)
places.near: South Coast Road at Anse Forbans/Quatre Bornes, ~30–35 min south of the airport by car or taxi; pairs with Anse Intendance and Takamaka in the same afternoon.
places.order: The afternoon-tea selection with a pot of tea; DoubleTree's warm signature chocolate-chip cookie on arrival is a guaranteed win with the kids.
places.notes: Hilton property page for DoubleTree Seychelles – Allamanda (afternoon tea / light bites with coastal views); coordinates from OpenStreetMap/Nominatim.
places.famousFor: Afternoon tea and light bites served with an open panorama over the south-coast reef — the most accessible non-resort-guest afternoon tea on Mahé's quiet southern shore.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.4 ★ (1,102) · Call ahead — non-resident afternoon tea depends on the day and can be seating-limited; prices are quoted in EUR at resorts. A quieter, cheaper alternative to the five-star north-coast hotels.
places.address: South Coast Road, Anse Forbans, Quatre Bornes, Takamaka, Mahé

places.name: Pointe Au Sel Bakery
places.area: Mahé — Pointe au Sel (east coast, near Anse Royale)
places.near: Pointe au Sel on the East Coast Road, between Au Cap and Anse Royale — right on the drive down to Le Jardin du Roi and the south coast beaches.
places.order: Whatever cake is fresh that morning, coconut tarts and sweet buns; whole cakes for occasions.
places.notes: KOEK.sc merchant listing pointe-au-sel-bakery.koek.sc; no verified coordinates for the shop itself, left blank.
places.famousFor: A neighbourhood bakery on the quiet east coast turning out cakes and sweet snacks at local prices — the sort of stop that costs a fifth of a hotel dessert.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.2 ★ (29) · Small local bakery — mornings are best, stock thins out by afternoon and it may close early. Bring SCR cash. · Location needs verification
places.address: Pointe au Sel, East Coast Road, Mahé

places.name: Gelateria Da Luca
places.near: On the main Grand'Anse–Baie Sainte Anne road at Anse Volbert, directly opposite Côte d'Or beach; ~15 min by car or taxi from Baie Ste Anne jetty.
places.order: Coconut gelato (the local favourite), banana and guava; the coppa tropicale sundae; crème caramel and the olive-oil-and-sea-salt flavour for the adults.
places.notes: Lonely Planet + Tripadvisor/Seychelles Promo listings for Ristorante-Gelateria Da Luca; coordinates from OpenStreetMap/Nominatim.
places.famousFor: The first ice-cream shop ever opened in Seychelles (1994, by Luca from Verona) and still the island's benchmark gelateria, across the road from Côte d'Or beach.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 3.8 ★ (300) · Takeaway counter rather than a sit-down café — buy and walk the beach. Same premises runs Ristorante Pizzeria Da Luca, so it doubles as an easy family dinner stop.
places.address: Grand'Anse Praslin – Baie Sainte Anne Road, Anse Volbert, Praslin

places.name: Sweet Occasions Seychelles
places.near: Victoria, Mahé — order-and-collect rather than a walk-in dessert counter; confirm the pickup point when you order.
places.order: A custom celebration cake or a mixed cupcake box ordered ahead through their Facebook page.
places.notes: Business Facebook page facebook.com/SweetOccasionsSeychelles (Victoria); no address or coordinates published, left blank.
places.famousFor: Made-to-order celebration cakes, cupcakes and dessert boxes — the local name people use for birthdays and family occasions in Victoria.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 3.7 ★ (3) · Order-ahead only — message at least 24–48h in advance. Handy if a birthday falls during the trip and the hotel patisserie is priced in euros. · Location needs verification

places.name: Le Rendezvous Cafeteria
places.near: Quincy Street, central Victoria, a couple of minutes' walk from the Clock Tower and directly opposite the Hindu temple.
places.order: A strong coffee or a fruit smoothie on the terrace; the daily hot local plate if you want a cheap lunch.
places.notes: Wanderlog Mahé cafés list and Tripadvisor entry for Le Rendezvous Cafeteria, Victoria.
places.famousFor: A genuine local Victoria cafeteria with a first-floor terrace looking over the colourful Arul Mihu Navasakthi Vinayagar Hindu temple.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.9 ★ (88) · Weekday business hours, early closing Saturday, closed Sunday. Very reasonably priced; cash is safest. No alcohol focus — it is a workaday cafeteria. Good sheltered spot when a Victoria downpour hits. · Location needs verification

places.name: Fruita Cabana
places.area: La Digue — Anse Source d'Argent (L'Union Estate)
places.near: Along the beach path at Anse Source d'Argent inside L'Union Estate, La Digue — cycle from La Passe (~15 min) and pay the L'Union Estate entry fee.
places.order: A cold green coconut, then a fresh passion-fruit or mango juice; skip the rum cocktails if you are keeping it dry.
places.notes: anjaonadventure.com La Digue restaurants and takeaways guide (2026), Cafés & Bars section.
places.famousFor: The beach shack you pass on the granite-boulder path at Anse Source d'Argent — fresh green coconuts opened in front of you at the world's most photographed beach.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.7 ★ (209) · Daylight hours only, tied to L'Union Estate opening (roughly 07:00–17:00) — the estate charges an entry fee (about SCR 150/EUR 10 per adult) separately. Cash only. Beach-shack pricing is higher than town; a coconut is a few hundred rupees for the group. Cocktails are sold, so it is not alcohol-free, but the draw is the juice and the setting. · Location needs verification
places.address: Anse Source d'Argent, L'Union Estate, La Digue

places.name: Café des Îles
places.near: Providence industrial area, south of Victoria on the east-coast road, ~10 min by car from the capital and close to Eden Island.
places.order: A bag of the current single-origin microlot (they have run Tanzanian SL28 among others) to take home; ask which cafés are pouring their beans that week.
places.notes: cafedesiles.com and the roastery's own Facebook/Instagram announcements; retail listing on wow.sc.
places.famousFor: Seychelles' only specialty coffee roastery, roasting small batches on-island and supplying most of the serious cafés and hotels in the country.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.6 ★ (238) · This is a roastery and wholesale operation, not a sit-down café — contact them (vincentboulle@cafedesiles.com) before turning up if you want to visit or buy at source; retail bags are also sold at wow.sc and in Victoria shops. Included here because it is the one address that matters for specialty-coffee travellers in Seychelles. · Location needs verification

places.name: Jo's Cafe
places.near: Central Victoria (Plus Code 9FH3+43V), walkable from the Clock Tower; ask a local — it is tucked away rather than on the main drag.
places.order: Iced coffee and a slice of the red velvet cake; freshly made sandwiches for a light lunch.
places.notes: Wanderlog Mahé cafés list entry for Jo's Cafe, Victoria.
places.famousFor: A small, little-known town café with mountain views that reviewers rate for the best iced coffee in Victoria.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.5 ★ (33) · Weekday daytime hours; small and can be full at lunch. Cheap to mid; carry cash. Small space — better for two or three people than a party of seven at once. · Location needs verification

places.name: Lannan Bakery
places.order: Cardamom bun or cinnamon bun (cinnamon butter, orange custard, rum syrup)
places.notes: Saved POI
places.famousFor: Award-winning viennoiserie; very long queues
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.4 ★ (1,445) · By Darcie Maher (ex-Palmerston); opened 2023; expect a long line · Location needs verification

places.name: Mimi's Café
places.cuisine: Café, cakes, tropical juices and ice cream
places.near: In the heart of La Passe, a short bicycle ride or walk from the La Digue ferry jetty — everyone on the island cycles here.
places.order: Coconut cheesecake with a coconut ice cream; a fresh fruit juice or smoothie; sandwiches for a light lunch.
places.notes: Tripadvisor ranking/rating for Mimi's Cafe, La Digue + anjaonadventure.com La Digue dining guide (2026).
places.famousFor: The best-loved café on La Digue and one of the island's top-rated eateries — known island-wide for its coconut cheesecake.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.4 ★ (724) · Breakfast through late afternoon; closed early evening. Reasonably priced for La Digue (where everything costs more than Mahé). Bring cash — card machines on La Digue are unreliable. Rated 4.7 on Tripadvisor and consistently in the island's top three. Fruit juices and ice cream make it an easy family stop mid-cycle.

places.name: No1 Baie Sainte Anne
places.cuisine: Coffee shop, smoothies, pastries, sandwiches, salads
places.near: Old School Building, Baie Sainte Anne, Praslin — walking distance from the Baie Ste Anne ferry jetty where the Cat Cocos from Mahé and the La Digue ferry dock.
places.order: Coffee with plant-based milk and a flavoured syrup; iced citronelle or a smoothie; local cakes 'lapatsek', 'mafelisi' or coconut tart from Jenny's Bakery next door.
places.notes: Seychelles Nation article 'Praslin welcomes trendy new coffee shop – the No1 Baie Ste Anne'.
places.famousFor: Praslin's trendiest gourmet coffee shop, opened by Seychellois couple Peter and Shirley in the Old School Building — widely called the best coffee on Praslin.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.4 ★ (149) · Daytime hours; hours are not published so check its Facebook page or call ahead, especially Sunday. Mid-priced for Praslin. Nespresso-based coffee with oat/soy milks and syrups; also does soft serve and slush for kids, plus an all-day English breakfast. Jenny Pomeroy's 30-year-old bakery shares the premises. · Location needs verification
places.address: Old School Building, Baie Sainte Anne, Praslin

places.name: Anchor Cafe & Restaurant
places.area: Mahé — Anse à la Mouche (west coast)
places.cuisine: Casual café, pizza, salads, local dishes
places.near: West Coast Road at Anse à la Mouche, ~30 min from the airport; on the SPTC bus route down the west coast.
places.order: Coffee or a cold juice with the sea view; a pizza or a Creole plate if you make it lunch.
places.notes: Wanderlog Mahé cafés list entry for Anchor Cafe & Restaurant, Anse à la Mouche.
places.famousFor: A relaxed roadside café-restaurant on the calm southwest coast with a wide-open Indian Ocean view over Anse à la Mouche bay.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.3 ★ (346) · Daytime into early evening; check by phone on Sundays. Budget to mid-priced. Bay-view terrace, easy parking, good half-way stop on a west-coast drive with the family. · Location needs verification
places.address: W Coast Rd, Anse à la Mouche, Mahé

places.name: Café 74 (Café Seventy Faure)
places.cuisine: Crepes, waffles, specialty coffee, breakfast combos
places.near: Arc Royale building on Mont Plaisir Road, opposite the University of Seychelles in the heart of Anse Royale, on the east coast ~20 min south of the airport.
places.order: A freshly made crepe or Belgian waffle with the house sauces; croque monsieur; specialty coffee and fresh local juice.
places.notes: Seychelles Nation feature 'Café 74 – a café with a difference' + Inside Seychelles listing for Café Seventy Faure.
places.famousFor: A café with a difference in the south of Mahé — everything is made in-house, and the book corner is curated by former Seychelles president Danny Faure; it doubles as a gallery for local artists.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.3 ★ (160) · Daytime hours, roughly 08:00–17:00, closed or short on Sunday; tel +248 2 527 774. Mid-priced. Batters, cakes and pesto are all made on site. Fully family-friendly and alcohol-free in character; the book corner keeps kids occupied. · Location needs verification
places.address: Arc Royale, Mont Plaisir Road, Anse Royale, Mahé

places.name: Le Jardin du Roi
places.cuisine: Creole café fare with garden spices, homemade sweets
places.near: About 2 km up the hill from Anse Royale beach on the east coast of Mahé — a steep drive, so hire car or taxi rather than the bus.
places.order: Coffee or citronelle (lemongrass) tea on the terrace with a spiced dessert; the vanilla and cinnamon products from the spice shop are the souvenir to take home.
places.notes: Le Jardin du Roi listings on Petit Futé, US News Travel and seychelles.com.co (hours, phone, garden/restaurant setup).
places.famousFor: An 18th-century spice-garden estate above Anse Royale with giant tortoises, a small museum and a hillside café-restaurant that cooks with spices picked in the garden.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.2 ★ (1,185) · Open daily 10:00–17:30; tel +248 4 371 313. Garden entry is charged separately from the café. Mid-priced. Guided hikes need 24 hours' notice. Excellent family stop — tortoises, museum and a view over Anse Royale. · Location needs verification

places.name: Coco Rouge Take Away and Cafe
places.near: On the main road through Baie Sainte Anne, Praslin, a short walk or hop from the ferry jetty; tel +248 2 581 014.
places.order: The smoked/grilled fish plate with rice and lentils; a fresh juice; a jar of the homemade preserves to take away.
places.notes: Tripadvisor reviews and the reevesroam.com write-up on Coco Rouge, Praslin (prices, style, phone).
places.famousFor: The roadside Creole institution of Baie Ste Anne — wood-smoked fresh fish and huge portions at prices no restaurant on Praslin can match.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.2 ★ (578) · Daytime; sells out of the day's dishes, so go early. Very cheap — mains from around SCR 55–100. Cash only in practice. Mostly takeaway with a few seats, so plan to eat it at the beach; simple and honest rather than pretty. Fish and curries dominate the menu.

places.name: La Dolce Vita
places.near: Central Victoria, short walk from the Clock Tower and the Sir Selwyn-Clarke Market (Plus Code 9FG2+QMF).
places.order: Espresso or affogato with a scoop of the coconut or passion-fruit gelato; a pastry or cake for the kids.
places.notes: Wanderlog Mahé cafés/breakfast lists describing La Dolce Vita, Victoria.
places.famousFor: Victoria's Italian gelateria-café — proper espresso and authentic gelato in the middle of the capital, and it serves food from breakfast through to dinner.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.2 ★ (380) · Long daily hours (roughly 08:00 to late evening). Mid-priced by local standards; gelato is a cheap treat. There is a full bar but the place reads as a café/gelateria. Air-conditioned indoor seating — a relief in Victoria's midday heat. · Location needs verification

places.name: Café Eden
places.cuisine: Coffee, all-day breakfast, pastries, pizza, gelato
places.near: Eden Plaza, on the Angel Fish Bayside marina walk on Eden Island, ~10 min by car or bus from Victoria over the Eden causeway; free parking at the plaza.
places.order: Flat white or cappuccino (oat/soy available), a slice of cheesecake or tiramisu, and the all-day breakfast plate; local Sharks ice cream in coconut or 'Black Hawaii'.
places.notes: Inside Seychelles directory listing for Café Eden (address, hours, owners, menu).
places.famousFor: The most polished coffee-and-cake stop on Mahé, opened 2021 by Lucy and Adrian Karberg, looking straight onto the Eden Island yacht marina.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.2 ★ (121) · Mon–Sat 08:00–21:00, Sun 10:00–18:00. Mid-range for Seychelles (roughly SCR 90–160 for coffee + cake); cards accepted; no booking needed. Plenty of vegetarian and vegan milk options; alcohol is on the list but the place is a daytime café, not a bar. Marina-side tables are shaded — good with kids. · Location needs verification
places.address: Eden Plaza, Angel Fish Bayside Marina, Eden Island, Mahé

places.name: Lansiv Café
places.cuisine: Tropical smoothies, fresh juice, sandwiches, Creole snacks
places.near: 157 Independence Avenue, central Victoria, next to the Seychelles National Museum of History — a 3 min walk from the Clock Tower and the market.
places.order: The 'Kreol La Digue' smoothie; any fresh local-fruit juice (soursop, passion fruit, mango); a sandwich or Creole snack alongside.
places.notes: Seychelles National Museums cafeteria page + Wanderlog/Evendo listings for Lansiv Café.
places.famousFor: The juice-and-smoothie stop of central Victoria, set on the veranda of a historic colonial government building right beside the National Museum, with a little herb garden.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.1 ★ (140) · Daytime only, roughly 08:00–16:00 and closed/short hours on Sunday — check before a late visit. Cheap (smoothies around SCR 60–90); bring cash, card acceptance is not guaranteed. Outdoor veranda seating, fully alcohol-free, and the fruit-based menu suits kids well. · Location needs verification

places.name: Quickbites Cafe @ Kumar Kumar Docklands
places.near: Kumar Kumar Docklands area, Victoria — a short drive from the town centre towards the port; easiest with a hire car or taxi.
places.order: Cappuccino with a croissant or a fruit tart; the doughnuts and cakes go quickly in the morning.
places.notes: Tripadvisor listing/reviews for Quickbites Cafe @ Kumar Kumar Docklands, Victoria.
places.famousFor: A tiny takeaway-and-coffee counter that regulars rate for the best coffee and freshly made pastries in its corner of Victoria.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.1 ★ (31) · Weekday mornings are its moment; expect it to shut early afternoon and on Sunday. Slightly higher priced than a corner shop but reviewers say the quality justifies it. Cash preferred. Takeaway-focused with very limited seating. · Location needs verification

places.name: Chatterbox Cafe
places.near: Marina boardwalk on Eden Island, a 3–4 min walk from Eden Plaza; car or bus from Victoria over the causeway.
places.order: Iced coffee or a tropical smoothie, plus a toasted sandwich or a small pizza to share.
places.notes: Wanderlog Mahé cafés list + Tripadvisor reviewer describing it as one of the best coffee venues in Seychelles.
places.famousFor: The bright-yellow marina café that locals repeatedly name as one of the best coffee venues in Seychelles; a long-running Eden Island fixture.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 3.3 ★ (176) · Daytime hours (opens around 08:00, closes late afternoon/early evening). Budget-to-mid pricing; cards usually accepted but carry some rupees. Casual and laid-back — easy with a big family group, plenty of outdoor tables. · Location needs verification
places.address: Eden Island Marina, Providence, Mahé (Plus Code 9F5G+HFF)

places.name: La Digue Bike Rental (La Passe)
places.near: Rental stands line the road at La Passe jetty and every guesthouse arranges bikes; arrive on the Cat Cocos or Cat Rose ferry from Praslin (~15 min) or Mahe (~1h45)
places.notes: Rental price per 2026 La Digue guides and Tripadvisor La Digue forum.
places.famousFor: The whole island runs on bicycles — a flat coastal ring road with almost no cars, the single best family activity in Seychelles
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 5 ★ (9) · About SCR 150 per bike per day (roughly EUR 10) in 2026, cheaper for multi-day; kids' bikes, tag-alongs and child seats exist but are limited — reserve ahead for a family of seven. Check brakes and get a lock. Book the ferry days ahead in peak season (Dec-Jan, Jul-Aug) · Location needs verification · Kids: 9+ solo; 5-8 in a child seat

places.name: National Mall
places.near: Central Washington, DC; served by multiple Metro stations (Smithsonian, Federal Triangle, L'Enfant Plaza).
places.order: Walk between the Lincoln Memorial, Washington Monument and US Capitol, visit the free Smithsonian museums, and see the cherry blossoms by the Tidal Basin.
places.notes: Saved POI
places.famousFor: Landmark national park and open green expanse in Washington, DC lined with monuments and Smithsonian museums.
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.8 ★ (139,846) · Free and open 24 hours; spring (late Mar-early Apr) is cherry blossom season. · Location needs verification

places.name: Anse Lazio
places.near: North-west Praslin beyond Anse Boudin; ~25-30 min taxi or hire car from Baie Sainte Anne jetty, then a short walk over the headland from the car park
places.notes: Family/snorkel notes per Tripadvisor + SeyVillas beach guide; coordinates from Wikipedia.
places.famousFor: Praslin's crescent of golden sand framed by takamaka trees and giant granite boulders, regularly ranked among the world's best beaches
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.8 ★ (3,226) · Free; no lifeguards. Reef-protected and shallow — the safest big beach on Praslin for young kids. Snorkelling is best at either rocky end. Arrive before 09:00 to beat tour boats; two beach restaurants for lunch and toilets · Kids: All ages — reef-calm, gentle slope

places.name: Anse Georgette
places.near: Drive to the Constance Lemuria gate on north-west Praslin, register at security, then walk 20-30 min up and down through the golf course to the beach; no vehicle access
places.notes: Access/permission rules per Constance Lemuria + Tripadvisor Praslin forum reports 2025-2026.
places.famousFor: A near-private white crescent inside the Constance Lemuria estate, reached on foot across the golf course — the classic 'earned' Seychelles beach
places.goodToKnow: ⭐ 4.8 ★ (1,692) · Beach is public and free, but access is controlled: non-guests should request permission in advance (email info@lemuriaresort.com or have your hotel phone ahead 3-5 days) — a daily cap of about 30 non-guests has applied. Rules keep changing, so confirm the week you go. No shade, no facilities, bring water; carry a golf-cart-free-hands bag for kids · Location needs verification · Kids: 9+ — 25-min walk, some shore break
places.address: Constance Lemuria Resort, Anse Kerlan, Praslin, Seychelles

places.name: Copolia Trail
places.area: Mahe — Sans Souci, Morne Seychellois NP
